sleep-chart/features/date_range_options_: Choose from Weekly, Bi-weekly, or Monthly views to track your sleep patterns.
sleep-chart/features/grayscale_optimized: Designed in grayscale for clear, cost-effective printing.
sleep-chart/features/printer_friendly_de: Optimized for A4 printing with clear grids and labels.
sleep-chart/features/visual_sleep_timeli: Each day shows a horizontal line marking your sleep period from bedtime to wake-up.
sleep-chart/how_to_use/step1: Select your preferred date range (Weekly / Bi-weekly / Monthly).
sleep-chart/how_to_use/step2: Choose the start day of the week (Sunday or Monday).
sleep-chart/how_to_use/step3: Click "Generate Chart" to create your sleep tracking chart.
sleep-chart/how_to_use/step4: Print the chart and manually mark your sleep periods each day.
sleep-chart/note: Generate and print sleep tracking charts with daily sleep timeline visualization.
sleep-chart/settings/blank_title: Leave the chart title blank (you can fill it in after printing)
